name: com.myradostudio/keycrm
title: KeyCRM (unofficial)
description: Unofficial server for KeyCRM: read orders, buyers and pipelines; create lead cards on opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: KEYCRM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the KeyCRM account.

environmentVariables.name: KEYCRM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the KeyCRM API. Change it only if KeyCRM gave you a different host.

environmentVariables.name: KEYCRM_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register the write tool (create a lead card in a pipeline). Off by default.
